concepts.reader_question: 需求預測變了，先看哪些批次？
concepts.description: Bright neutral desk, blank partner report sheets beside a wafer protective carrier; separate sheets represent reports to reconcile, not actual statuses or forecast charts. Demand-change planning hook; blank paper only. Exact approved words only. Blank paper everywhere; no chart, tick, date, status, forecast curve, metric, technical chip UI, customer facility/marks or geography decoration. Keep full-width source paragraphs on white at least body-sized; shrink scene before type. Official logo once, exact category/sequence, no extra header label.
